references.text: David prophesied about the Messiah's sufferings, which include being mocked, whipped, and crucified.
Daniel predicts a time when 'a Messiah shall be cut off,' pointing forward to Jesus' death.
Isaiah describes a servant who suffers for others, including being beaten, foreshadowing Jesus' whipping.
Isaiah speaks of one wounded for our transgressions, a prophecy of Christ's suffering and death on the cross.
Jesus predicts his own suffering, death, and resurrection.
Jesus again predicts his suffering, death by crucifixion, and resurrection.
The Acts of the Apostles refers to the prophecies about the Messiah's sufferings that were fulfilled in Jesus.
